entries.rationale: Adds the canonical screening verb. The tool filters and ranks launchpad tokens and echoes the filters it applied (manifests/tokens.ts, tokens-params.ts), which is `discover`. It also breaks the pools.token / pools.tokens near-typo pair, see protocol-naming-2.md.

Near-typo resolution and canonical by-id verb. `pools.token` and `pools.tokens` differ by one character while doing entirely different things; the singular resource plus `get` now states the by-address detail read (api group joined with on-chain state at a pinned block, manifests/token.ts:11-16).

Regrouped under the resource it searches, symmetric with trench__tokens_search. Free-text name or symbol lookup over the same token rows pools__tokens_discover returns (manifests/search.ts:11-16), with a cursor continuation.
Names the scope. Candles are always read for ONE token (manifests/candles.ts:15), so the singular scoping resource is part of the name; `list` is the canonical verb for the bounded, ordered series.
Existing snake words preserved, canonical verb appended; symmetric with trench__my_launches_list.

Words preserved, order normalized to resource-then-verb so the fund-moving verb lands last like every other mutation in the catalog (launch_execute, trade_execute, bridge_execute). Resource is the creator fee stream a pools.fun token has earned; actionKind user_wallet_broadcast (manifests/claim.ts:31-32).
mechanical; three-word action preserved for the same reason as trench__launch_request_form, the form is the approval.

Names the resource and adds the canonical verb. The tool lists the tokenised stocks a launch can pair against, each row carrying the factory's own pricingMode and launchable flag read at a pinned block (manifests/launch-assets.ts), so it is a bounded, offset-paged list rather than a screen.

Existing snake words preserved, canonical by-id verb appended. The read answers for ONE token and ONE wallet against the distributor the suite deployer emitted (manifests/holder-rewards.ts), which is a `get`, not a list; the fund-moving claim is a separate tool so the read keeps the neutral verb.
